easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
The permanent that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to Life and Limb, causing Curse of the Restless Dead to trigger.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.
